name: tabs
description: Native guidance for a local-selection Picker with the platform segmented style; app navigation stays with TabView.
docs: Apply `.pickerStyle(.segmented)` directly to a native `Picker` for local tab selection. Keep `TabView` for app-level navigation. The registry adds no wrapper, because the one-line native style is the entire treatment.
accessibility: Retains native Picker selection and segmented-control semantics.
Keeps local selection caller-owned and does not replace app-level TabView navigation.
Requires concise visible segment labels that remain distinguishable at large text sizes.
Inherits enabled state, tint, and layout direction.
